def build_row(r, cycle_idx):
    pattern = []
    for i in range(26):  # cols 2-27 (inclusive)
        if i == 0:  # Column 2, always 4
            pattern.append(4)
        else:
            pos = (cycle_idx + (i - 1)) % 5
            val = cycle[pos]
            pattern.append(val)

def get_cycle_idx(r):
